title: Datapass mission (dbt, Terminal and Infra Lab packs)
$comment: Generated by scripts/authoring/gen_json_schemas.py from the runtime's pydantic model. Do not edit.

AirflowCheck.description: An Airflow DAG file, parsed (never executed) and its schedule simulated up to `now` (Airflow 3 semantics).
AirflowCheck.title: AirflowCheck

AnyOfCheck.description: Passes when one of its checks passes (for example: the script in bash or in PowerShell).
AnyOfCheck.title: AnyOfCheck

AzureAlertCheck.description:
A metric alert rule of the simulated subscription on `scope` and `metric` (its name is the learner's), and
what it does when replayed over the mission's metric scenario.
AzureAlertCheck.title: AzureAlertCheck

AzureResourceCheck.description: A resource of the simulated subscription, by ARM type and name.
AzureResourceCheck.title: AzureResourceCheck

BoardCheck.description: The board file itself: a query on ref(model), a filter variable, a chart type.
BoardCheck.title: BoardCheck

CsvCheck.description: A CSV file: its header and rows (values compared as trimmed text; quoting does not matter).
CsvCheck.title: CsvCheck

DctValidateCheck.description: `dct validate --json <board>`: the result comes with the check request (the host ran the real dct).
DctValidateCheck.title: DctValidateCheck

DockerBuildCheck.description:
The build itself, simulated from the Dockerfile and the build context (nothing is built): which steps stay
cached after a code change, and which paths .dockerignore keeps out of the context.
DockerBuildCheck.title: DockerBuildCheck

DockerContainerCheck.description: A container of the simulated engine (by name, or by compose service), its state and whether it answers.
DockerContainerCheck.title: DockerContainerCheck

DockerImageCheck.description: An image of the simulated Docker engine.
DockerImageCheck.title: DockerImageCheck

FreshnessConfigCheck.description: A source table's freshness rules in target/manifest.json.
FreshnessConfigCheck.title: FreshnessConfigCheck

FreshnessResultCheck.description: target/sources.json written by `dbt source freshness`: the status of each listed source table.
FreshnessResultCheck.title: FreshnessResultCheck

GitFileCheck.description: A file as committed at `ref` (not the working tree): content, mode, line endings.
GitFileCheck.title: GitFileCheck

GitIgnoreCheck.description:
The repository's own ignore rules (.gitignore files, .git/info/exclude; not the learner's global excludes
file) and what the index tracks.
GitIgnoreCheck.title: GitIgnoreCheck

GitLogCheck.description: The commits of `ref` (only those not in `since`, when given): subjects, merges, ancestry, message format.
GitLogCheck.title: GitLogCheck

GitRepoCheck.description: The repository itself: rooted at `repo`, the current branch, a clean tree, no merge or rebase in progress.
GitRepoCheck.title: GitRepoCheck

GitStep.description: One step of a fixture's history, run by the runtime as fixed git commands (never a shell string).
GitStep.title: GitStep

InfraFixture.description:
What an Infra Lab mission folder starts as: the pack's `project/` overlay, these files, the simulated world
(merged over the lab's default world: subscription, Docker engine, cluster, metric scenarios), then simulated
commands played before the learner arrives (for example: deploy yesterday's version to the cluster).
InfraFixture.title: InfraFixture

JournalCheck.description: The Infra Lab shell's journal (.infralab/journal.jsonl): commands the learner ran, by regular expression.
JournalCheck.title: JournalCheck

K8sDeploymentCheck.description: A Deployment of the simulated cluster: image, ready pods, probes, strategy, and its last rollout.
K8sDeploymentCheck.title: K8sDeploymentCheck

K8sHpaCheck.description:
A HorizontalPodAutoscaler of the simulated cluster: its target and bounds, whether it can compute a replica
count, and what it did during the replay of the mission's recorded load.
K8sHpaCheck.title: K8sHpaCheck

K8sIngressCheck.description: An Ingress of the simulated cluster, and what GET http://<host><path> gets through the ingress controller.
K8sIngressCheck.title: K8sIngressCheck

K8sServiceCheck.description: A Service of the simulated cluster: its endpoints (ready pods it selects) and whether traffic reaches the app.
K8sServiceCheck.title: K8sServiceCheck

ListingCheck.description: The entries of a folder (relative POSIX paths; `.git` is never listed), filtered by a name pattern.
ListingCheck.title: ListingCheck

NodeCheck.description: A node of target/manifest.json and its configuration.
NodeCheck.title: NodeCheck

PathCheck.description: A path in the mission folder is a file, a folder, or absent.
PathCheck.title: PathCheck

ReferenceStep.description:
How the smokes play the reference solution. dbt Lab: steps in order (load a batch, run a real command).
Terminal Lab: each step is a whole solution script (`solution/solve.sh`, `solution/solve.ps1`), played on a fresh
fixture of its own by scripts/terminal_missions_smoke.py; every one must pass.
ReferenceStep.title: ReferenceStep

RenderCheck.description: A `dct render --format json` output: a chart's data must add up to the same total as a SQL query.
RenderCheck.title: RenderCheck

Requirement.description: A precondition (for example: the second day's data was loaded), with what to do when it is not met.
Requirement.title: Requirement

RunCheck.description: target/run_results.json of the learner's last dbt command.
RunCheck.title: RunCheck

ScriptCheck.description: A shell script's TEXT, comments removed. Datapass never runs it.
ScriptCheck.title: ScriptCheck

SqlCheck.description: Read-only SQL on the workspace catalog, compared (order-independent) to the expected rows.
SqlCheck.title: SqlCheck

TerminalFixture.description: What a Terminal Lab mission folder starts as: the pack's `project/` overlay, these files, a repository.
TerminalFixture.title: TerminalFixture

TestCheck.description: A generic data test on a model's column, still there and still an error (not warn, no where filter).
TestCheck.title: TestCheck

TextCheck.description: A text file (UTF-8, or UTF-16 with a BOM as Windows PowerShell 5.1 writes it).
TextCheck.title: TextCheck

TfConfigCheck.description:
The .tf files themselves (read, never executed): resources and how they are declared, variables, outputs,
module calls, and whether every .tf file of the folder is laid out as terraform fmt would.
TfConfigCheck.title: TfConfigCheck

TfPlanCheck.description:
A fresh simulated `terraform plan` of the files as they are now (with the -var and -var-file options of the
learner's last successful apply): it must succeed, and show no changes when `changes` is false.
TfPlanCheck.title: TfPlanCheck

TfStateCheck.description: terraform.tfstate (written by the simulated apply): addresses present or absent, attribute values.
TfStateCheck.title: TfStateCheck

UnitTestCheck.description:
dbt unit tests (dbt Core 1.8+) of a model in target/manifest.json: how many, which columns their expected rows
pin, and that each one passed in the learner's last dbt command.
UnitTestCheck.title: UnitTestCheck
